candidates.name: Ken Paxton
candidates.bio: Texas attorney general since 2015 and a former state senator and state representative. Won the Republican nomination in a May runoff against Sen. John Cornyn.

candidates.name: James Talarico
candidates.bio: State representative from Round Rock since 2019 and a former middle-school teacher. Campaigning on cost of living, healthcare and ending tariffs.

candidates.name: Ted Brown
candidates.bio: Libertarian nominee campaigning on repealing the federal gas tax, ending tariffs, and ending U.S. military involvement in the Middle East.

candidates.name: Greg Abbott
candidates.bio: Governor since 2015, seeking a fourth term. Former Texas attorney general and Texas Supreme Court justice.

candidates.name: Gina Hinojosa
candidates.bio: State representative from Austin since 2017, civil rights and union lawyer, and former Austin ISD board president.

candidates.name: Pat Dixon
candidates.role: Former Libertarian Party of Texas chair
candidates.bio: Former chair of the Libertarian Party of Texas.

candidates.name: Dan Patrick
candidates.bio: Lieutenant governor since 2015 and a former state senator. Presides over the Texas Senate.

candidates.name: Vikki Goodwin
candidates.bio: State representative from Austin. Running on public school funding and a state-run health coverage option.

candidates.name: Anthony Cristo
candidates.bio: Libertarian nominee.

candidates.name: Kevin McCormick

candidates.name: Mayes Middleton

candidates.name: Nathan Johnson

candidates.name: Tom Oxford

candidates.name: Mindy Bumgarner

candidates.name: Amy Taylor

candidates.name: Andy Eads

candidates.name: Nick Pappas

candidates.name: Pat Fallon

candidates.name: Jason Pearce

candidates.name: Ronny Jackson

candidates.name: Mark Nair

candidates.name: Brandon Gill

candidates.name: Steven Shook

candidates.name: Phil Gray

candidates.name: Richard Hayes

candidates.name: Ray Stith

candidates.name: Darren Hamilton

props.title: Town of Flower Mound, Proposition A
props.text: Reauthorizes the local sales tax of 1/4 of 1% for street maintenance and repair for four more years. It doesn’t raise the current rate.

props.title: Bartonville, Justin and Lake Dallas, Proposition A
props.text: Each town asks voters to reauthorize its street-maintenance sales tax.

props.title: Town of Double Oak, Proposition A
props.text: Legalizes alcohol sales, including mixed beverages.

props.title: Town of Hickory Creek, Proposition A
props.text: Ends the Economic Development Corporation and adopts a 1.75% sales tax.

props.title: City of Dallas, Proposition A
props.text: $443 million in public safety bonds; a tax increase.

props.title: City of Plano, Proposition A
props.text: Financing a multipurpose arena through several possible taxes; a tax increase.

props.title: City of Denton and The Colony
props.text: Denton votes on City Council District 1 (unexpired term); The Colony votes on City Council Places 3–6.

props.title: Water, utility and improvement districts
props.text: Several MUD, water and improvement districts have bond and tax propositions. Check your sample ballot to see if one is yours.
